role: Pure decision functions and constants guarding the strap's on-device recording: start preconditions, status interpretation, unattended-fetch decision, end-of-session stop, transfer budgets, retry schedule, recording-to-session matching, saved/unrecovered checks, start-refusal classification and low-battery warnings.
types: StrapRecordingPolicy.StatusOutcome: struct — isRecordingOnDevice + optional new RecordingState
StrapRecordingPolicy.TransferBudget: struct — per-phase deadlines (stopSeconds, downloadSeconds) + showsProgress; statics unattended (45/120 s) and attended (45/300 s)
state: mem:StrapRecordingPolicy.TransferBudget.unattended (45 s stop, 120 s download, no progress)
toplevel: Static constants listed in state; no other top-level behaviour.

units.does: Start preconditions: notConnected unless API, device id and .connected; alreadyRecording if app state is not .idle or the strap reports recording; else startVeritySense or startH10 by device type.

branches.cond: missing API/device id or not connected

units.does: Maps a strap status reading to app state: ongoing → (onDevice true, .recording); not ongoing → (onDevice false, .idle only if current was .recording, else nil = leave transitional states alone).
Unattended fetch decision: notConnected without API/device id; H10 (or unknown type) always fetchH10; Verity Sense fetches only while its offline recording runs.
Whether the session end must send the H10 stop: false for Verity Sense; else API && device id && recording on device.
Retry schedule: give up at attempt ≥ 9 or on deterministic failures, or on nothingListed when not just stopped; attempts 1-3 pause 500 ms, 4-6 pause 1000 ms, 7-8 reset the link.
True when a recording started no earlier than sessionStart − 2 s (idStampToleranceSeconds) and less than 24 h after sessionStart.
Whether the strap holds a dated recording the app has not saved: false without a stored recording or start date, else !recordingIsSaved(alreadyDownloaded, predatesDownloadRecord, heldOnDisk).

branches.cond: no stored recording or no start date

units.does: A strap recording is saved — and may be cleared from the strap — only when it was downloaded or predates the download ledger AND it is on this device (heldOnDisk: an archived session or a rescue backup near its start). A download alone no longer counts: the ledger is written when the beats arrive, before anything stores them, so a failed backup or an app killed before the night was saved left a recording marked downloaded that only the strap held.
Classifies an arming error: strapBatteryTooLow → .batteryTooLow, strapHoldsUndownloadedRecording → .undownloadedRecordingOnStrap, anything else → .retryable.
After a battery refusal, allow re-arming only when a current battery reading exceeds the level at refusal (or 20% when none was recorded).

branches.effect: compares against lowBatteryWarningPercent (20); else against refusedAt

units.does: Warn before an armed night when a non-Verity strap reports battery ≤ 20%.

branches.cond: Verity Sense or no battery reading
